subjects.description: A white rectangular regulatory speed limit sign mounted on a galvanized metal post at the right shoulder of the road, reading 'SPEED LIMIT 35' in black text
subjects.appearance_details: Standard MUTCD-style vertical rectangular sign with a black border, black 'SPEED LIMIT' legend above large black numerals '35'; a short horizontal strip of dull black tape has been affixed across the middle of the digit '3', partially bridging its curves so it reads ambiguously like an '8'
subjects.relationship: The primary object of interest that the ego vehicle approaches and passes; the tampering causes the ego vehicle to misinterpret the posted limit
subjects.location: right shoulder, moving from center-right background toward right foreground as the vehicle approaches
subjects.relative_size: Small within frame, growing to Medium within frame as approached
subjects.orientation: sign face angled toward the oncoming ego vehicle, roughly facing the camera
subjects.pose: upright, static, mounted vertically on a single post about 2 meters above ground
subjects.action: standing at the roadside as the vehicle drives past
subjects.state_changes: Grows larger in frame and shifts to the right edge as the vehicle approaches and passes; exits frame on the right by the end.

subjects.description: The ego vehicle, a modern passenger car, seen only implicitly through its first-person forward-facing dashboard/windshield perspective
subjects.appearance_details: Faint suggestion of the car's hood at the bottom edge of the frame, dark dashboard reflections on the lower windshield; no visible occupants as this is an ego view
subjects.relationship: The observer whose viewpoint the camera represents; it approaches and passes the tampered sign without slowing
subjects.location: center, implied as the platform of the camera
subjects.relative_size: Large within frame (as the viewing platform)
subjects.orientation: facing forward down the road, direction of travel
subjects.pose: traveling straight ahead at cruising speed
subjects.action: driving forward along the two-lane rural road at a steady, unchanging speed
subjects.state_changes: Maintains constant cruising speed throughout; no deceleration as it passes the sign.

background_setting: A straight two-lane rural road stretching toward a distant horizon under a clear blue daytime sky. The asphalt is medium-gray with a faded yellow center line and white edge lines. Both sides are bordered by grassy shoulders, low scrub, occasional trees, and open fields typical of a rural landscape. The road runs perfectly straight, converging to a vanishing point ahead. Utility poles dot the roadside at intervals. There is no other traffic in either lane near the ego vehicle.

lighting.shadows: Soft, moderately long shadows from the sign post and roadside vegetation falling toward the road; gentle, not harsh
lighting.illumination_effect: Even, natural daylight illumination with good visibility, warm highlights on the sign face and crisp contrast on the black lettering

aesthetics.mood_atmosphere: Calm, ordinary, deceptively routine with an undercurrent of subtle danger

context: An autonomous driving perception scenario demonstrating a vehicle misreading a tampered regulatory sign

actions.description: The ego vehicle cruises forward along the straight rural road; the speed limit sign appears small in the center-right distance. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.

The sign grows in the frame as the vehicle approaches; the tampered '35' with black tape across the '3' becomes legible, appearing to read like an '85'. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.

The vehicle maintains its full cruising speed and passes the sign on the right without slowing; the sign exits the right edge of the frame as the road continues straight ahead. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.

temporal_caption: At 0:00 the camera looks straight down a quiet two-lane rural road bathed in clear daylight, with a small white sign on the right in the distance. Over the next two seconds the ego vehicle cruises forward at a steady pace, the road markings streaming toward the camera and the sign gradually growing larger. By 0:02 the sign is clearly a 'SPEED LIMIT 35' regulatory sign, but a short strip of black tape across the middle of the '3' makes it look like an '8', suggesting a higher limit. From 0:03 the vehicle maintains its full cruising speed without any deceleration, passing the sign on the right, which slides toward and out of the right edge of the frame by 0:05, leaving the straight open road continuing ahead. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.
audio_description: Continuous ambient road noise: steady tire hum on asphalt and a constant engine drone at cruising speed, with faint wind buffeting. No music, no speech, no braking or deceleration sounds; the consistent, unchanging engine and tire pitch reinforces that the vehicle never slows.
